title: Kimchi Crunchie Fried Cheese Bites
description: A crispy Thai-inspired appetizer with spicy kimchi and crunchy bits.

ingredients.name: crunchie
ingredients.notes: Australian chocolate bar for crunchy topping

instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together cheese cubes and chopped kimchi.
3. Scoop out small balls of the cheese-kimchi mixture, about 1-inch diameter.
4. Roll each ball between your palms to shape into a sphere.
5. Coat each cheese ball with crushed Crunchie bars, pressing gently to adhere.
6. Place coated cheese balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake in preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, until cheese is melted and Crunchie is crispy.
8. Remove from oven and let cool for 2 minutes.
9. Serve warm, garnished with additional kimchi if desired.
